# unraid_vms (Data Source)

All virtual machines. Requires `READ_ANY` on `VMS`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_vms" "all" {}

output "running_vms" {
  value = [for v in data.unraid_vms.all.vms : v.name if v.state == "RUNNING"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `vms` (Attributes List) List of VMs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) VM identifier (UUID).
- `name` (String) VM name.
- `state` (String) VM state, e.g. `RUNNING` or `SHUTOFF`.
